title: A Chunky Sea Animal From the Age of Dinosaurs
paragraphs: Scientists found a new animal. It lived in the sea a very long time ago.
The animal lived about 160 million years ago. Its fossil is from Wyoming, in the United States. The animal looked like a small squid.
Its hard part is big and thick. It is about ten centimetres long. The scientists know only two fossils. They are in a museum now.

questions.a: From Wyoming, in the United States.

questions.q: How many fossils do scientists know?
